pg_configurator 0.11.0
Source: https://github.com/O2eg/pg_configurator
License: MIT
The offline web calculation and UI are bundled unchanged; the page entry point
accepts report inputs before mounting. Rebuild instructions, source hashes,
copyright and logo provenance are in pg-configurator.NOTICE.txt. The full MIT
license is distributed in pg-configurator.LICENSE.txt and embedded in reports.
